FlashInfer SM120 MXFP4/MXFP8 split MegaMoE
========================================

The CUBINs in tools/fastllm_pytools/kernels/mxfp4_ep are compiled from the
FlashInfer 0.7.2 SM120 split CuTeDSL MegaMoE kernels and its Triton input-staging
kernel. The upstream implementation is not claimed as original FastLLM code.

Upstream source:
https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/tree/main/flashinfer/moe_ep/kernel_src/sm120/split_cutedsl_megakernel
FlashInfer is provided under the Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE.flashinfer.
Compiler-package notices are retained as LICENSE.cutlass-dsl and LICENSE.triton.
No CUTLASS DSL host runtime, Torch library, Triton runtime, or FlashInfer Python
package is embedded in the deployed CUBIN package.

FastLLM additions: same-process peer allocation for build-time export; graph
serialization with pointer/TMA/peer-offset relocation; native CUDA graph loading;
weight packing; build-time benchmark selection between upstream direct return
and rank-local combine; stable-address workspace sharing; and native FastLLM
graph integration. The compiled GPU arithmetic kernels retain the upstream
implementation. Native weight packing follows the
upstream interleave and scale-swizzle layouts. Graph integration follows the
upstream Green Context dependency protocol and preserves CUDA edge ports.

UPSTREAM.json records source-file hashes, compiler versions, target dimensions,
and binary hashes. Runtime contains no compiler. Re-exporting for another target
requires the build-only tools/mega_moe_sm120/export.py dependencies; see USAGE.txt.
